text:
Predicates:
Born(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
LoanedOutTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to club y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for club y.
SameClub(x, y) ::: x is in the same club as y.
FootballClub(x) ::: x is a football club.

Premises:
Born(ailtonSilva, 1995) ∧ LoanedOutTo(ailtonSilva, braga) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton and was loaned out to Braga.
PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ::: Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga and plays for Nautico.
PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico.
SameClub(nautico, braga) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
FootballClub(fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.

Conclusion:
¬∃x (PlaysFor(x, nautico) ∧ Brazillian(x)) ::: No one playing for Nautico is Brazilian.
